def two_factor_probe(X, gg, lam):
    """returns d_place, probe v with v.d_place=1 and v.d_bird=0, global mean; ridge-regularised within-group covariance."""
    mu_ = np.stack([X[gg==k].mean(0) for k in range(4)])
